# Held-out exercises for interface-depth, reported apart from exercises.txt.
# Whoever revises the skill should not read this file or its fixtures.

# A paged client with a loop beside it that ends early. Graded: every live order is in
# the file, past short and empty pages, as the client's docstring describes them.
[all-pages] add export_csv(path) to export.py that writes every order as id,customer,cents under that header row | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# Setting a level is easy to do behind the class's back. Graded: levels match the
# count and the audit trail still adds up to them, as the class says it does.
[bulk-bypass] add apply_count(inventory, counted) to counting.py, where counted maps sku to the quantity found on the shelf, and make the stock levels match it | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
